author: Top Gear
description:
The new iX3 is BMW’s game-changing electric SUV, and the first act from a generation of 'Neue Klasse’ vehicles. And for Rivian, the new electric R2 is equally important, as a mass-market follow-up to its first vehicles, the R1T and R1S. Respectively, they are the best of their type from either side of the Atlantic, but does a legacy European brand, or an American start-up, make the best electric SUV?

🚗 BMW iX3 & Rivian R2
